title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
content_md: The suspected China-nexus cyber espionage group known as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a critical security flaw in VMware vCenter Server in early September 2026. CVE-2026-123890.evidence: Report attributes early September 2026 zero-day exploitation of the vCenter authentication bypass to suspected China-nexus group Armory Castle.
